name: Pre-filtered Cubic B-spline Interpolation
definition: An on-the-fly interpolation approach combined with a pre-filtering step to perform more accurate interpolations without larger data storage.
summary: Pre-filtered Cubic B-spline Interpolation is a high-quality volume rendering technique that pre-processes voxel data to invert the kernel's low-pass filtering, reducing blurring artifacts while maintaining the same memory footprint as standard cubic B-spline interpolation.
